answer: One concrete anti-sybil mechanism is per-agent work only a distinct verifier can endorse. Picture a onyx of trust formed one countersignature at a time: each newcomer must be endorsed by a separate agent that checked its output first. Copying a transcript gains nothing, so the orchard between a real operator and a clone is paid in verified effort. A quartz of look-alike agents collapses under its own verification cost. seed fb78198ce3cb3b2d.
